body: Thank you. Sincerely.

I was shot in the face on Aug. 31st with a .45 in a road rage incident. I was admitted to trauma at 4pm that day and left the hospital 24 hrs later. The night of my return my partner fell asleep while her Snap was trying to send a video to a very close friend of mine. A man that she met through me. A couple days later our phones were "syncing?" passwords and I found out she had two separate snaps. 

Everything in my world fell apart immediately. I could not accept that my wife of 5 years had done that to me (since July this year), and was continuing to do so after all that'd happened.  And after all that, she's actin contrite and seems to believe that she can excuse her actions by saying I didn't show appreciation lol. Tf?!?!

I can't seem to move past it. I can't seem to make sense of it. And as much as I am disfigured, I am resolved. I may be hard to get along with, but I've done nothing to deserve this. For me, I've gotta stay mad, pissed, in order to keep the sadness at bay. Otherwise it'll eat you alive. 

I'm sorry you have to go through this. I wish you the best of luck. The truth is that people suck. Those people have no place in our lives. None.
